title: Google Pics Takes Aim at Canva With Prompt-First Design
dek: Google is moving deeper into creative software with Google Pics, an AI-first product positioned around prompting rather than conventional design workflows.
socialCaption: Google is taking on Canva and Adobe with Google Pics, an AI-first creative tool built around prompts instead of conventional design workflows. The business question is whether faster creation can still deliver the control and brand consistency teams need.
